title: Leading coefficient of a normalized falling factorial
statement: For every natural number $k$, let $(X)_{k}=X(X-1)	ext{ more precisely, }\prod_{j=0}^{k-1}(X-j)$ be the falling-factorial polynomial. The leading coefficient of $\frac{1}{k!}(X)_{k}$ is $\frac{1}{k!}$, with the empty product interpreted as $1$ when $k=0$.
